Artistix Onyx Laptop Backpack – Black | 32L High Density Nylon Laptop Bag

The Artistix Onyx Laptop Backpack, Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon is designed for professionals, students, and travelers who need durability, smart storage, and modern style in one premium backpack. Built with precision and functionality, this black laptop backpack combines rugged construction with a sleek, minimal look suitable for office, college, business travel, and daily commuting.

Crafted from high density nylon, the Artistix Onyx Laptop Backpack offers excellent resistance to wear, moisture, and daily rough use. With dimensions of 46 (H) x 32 (W) x 20 (D) cms and a generous capacity of 32 litres, it provides ample space to carry your laptop, documents, gadgets, clothes, and accessories while maintaining a lightweight feel of just 1.0 kg.

Smart Laptop Protection & Spacious Storage

This premium laptop backpack features a padded laptop compartment suitable for laptops up to 15.6 inches, ensuring your device stays safe during travel. Multiple internal pockets help organize chargers, power banks, notebooks, and office essentials efficiently. The Artistix Onyx Laptop Backpack, Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon is ideal for professionals looking for a reliable office backpack with smart organization.

The spacious main compartment allows you to pack files, books, or travel essentials effortlessly, making it a perfect choice for a travel laptop or business. Its structured design ensures the bag retains its shape even when fully loaded.

Comfortable, Lightweight & Travel-Friendly

Designed for long hours of wear, this black laptop comes with adjustable, padded shoulder straps and a breathable back panel that reduces strain on your shoulders and back. Despite its large storage capacity, the making it comfortable for daily use, office commutes, and airport travel.

The ergonomic design makes it an excellent choice for a college , office laptop bag, or business travel . The sleek black finish complements both formal and casual outfits, adding a professional edge to your daily carry.

Premium Build for Everyday Use

The use of high density nylon material ensures durability, water resistance, and long-lasting performance. Strong zippers, reinforced stitching, and a solid base make the Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon suitable for heavy daily use without compromising on style.

Whether you are heading to work, attending meetings, traveling for business, or commuting daily, this black nylon laptop delivers reliable performance and modern aesthetics.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Colour: Black

  • Dimensions: 46 (H) x 32 (W) x 20 (D) cms
  • Capacity: 32 Litres

This Onyx Laptop has a sleek design, while offering maximum functionality. Dedicated padded compartment for secure laptop protection. The Zippered front pocket provides inner compartments for basic organization of notes, documents and stationery. At the back of the bag, lumbar padding doubles as a smuggler’s pocket for small items of value, while side pockets provide further storage space.
